properties.name: Meander neck (unnamed reach)
properties.method: Relative sinuosity hotspot (along-channel / straight-line length over a 5 km window)
properties.explain: Tight meander loop: in high flows water can jump the neck (avulsion/cut-off), flooding farms 'blind' to the main channel and creating ox-bow pools.
